game.name: Dark Spasm
game.desc: Dark Spasm is a third person shooter heavily inspired by Berzerk, Wolfenstein 3D, Doom, and Xybots. You are the prisoner of the planet called Labyrinet, where tons of dangerous robots are trying to kill you! Your tiny blaster may can destroy some low-level guards but It's no use for the heavily armored ones. Find better equipments quickly and keep running for your life. Don't forget saving your captured friends too!
